newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-INDIA FINED FOR SLOW OVER RATE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA FINED FOR SLOW OVER RATE.

text.p: The Indian team have been fined almost double their match fee for their slow over rate in the second and final test, the Board of Control for Cricket in Sri Lanka (BCCSL) said on Wednesday.
The BCCSL said in a statment that members of the Indian team were each fined 195 percent of their match fee by the referee John Reid as they had bowled 22 overs less than required.

"I am disappointed that the Indian team has created a record in over rate fines, but am equally concerned that very little effort was made to speed up despite being advised daily of their position," the statement quoted Reid as saying.
